AnalyticsSummary.title: AnalyticsSummary
AnalyticsSummary.description:
Aggregated analytics for the malware analytics dashboard.

Consolidates detection, alert, report and model data behind a single
endpoint so the dashboard does not have to stitch together several
module-specific calls on the frontend.

BehaviorCapability.title: BehaviorCapability
BehaviorCapability.description: One inferred capability, with the static evidence that raised it.

type.title: Type
type.description: Evidence source: yara | string | api | network | metadata | signature

BehaviorProfile.title: BehaviorProfile
BehaviorProfile.description:
Static behavioral-analysis output (Milestone 3 AI Prediction Module).

Derived entirely from imports, PE structure, YARA family tags and
suspicious strings -- the file is never executed.

attack_chain.title: Attack Chain
attack_chain.description: Ordered tactics that were hit (kill-chain order)

attack_chain.title: Attack Chain
attack_chain.description: Ordered tactics that were hit (kill-chain order)

observed.title: Observed
observed.description: True if behavior was inferred from static signals

risk_contribution.title: Risk Contribution
risk_contribution.description: Points contributed to behavioral risk score

Detection.title: Detection
Detection.description: One entry in the detection log - written for every analysed file.

FileHashes.title: FileHashes
FileHashes.description: Cryptographic digests of the uploaded sample.

file_type.title: File Type
file_type.description: Human-readable file type from magic bytes.

magic_hex.title: Magic Hex
magic_hex.description: Hex of the first bytes of the file.

extension.title: Extension
extension.description: Declared file extension, lowercased (if the upload name is known).

extension_matches_content.title: Extension Matches Content
extension_matches_content.description: Whether the declared extension is consistent with the detected content type. False is a classic disguise indicator.

likely_packed.title: Likely Packed
likely_packed.description: Heuristic: binary content with high entropy, suggesting packing/encryption.

likely_text.title: Likely Text
likely_text.description: Whether the sample looks like a text file.

FileMetadata.title: FileMetadata
FileMetadata.description: Static metadata derived from the sample without executing it.

MLPrediction.title: MLPrediction
MLPrediction.description: Output of the ML prediction service.

ManagedUser.title: ManagedUser
ManagedUser.description: A user as seen by an administrator.

ReportRecord.title: ReportRecord
ReportRecord.description: One entry in the generated-report history (investigation or summary).

ThreatIntelResult.title: ThreatIntelResult
ThreatIntelResult.description:
Best-effort VirusTotal enrichment, keyed by SHA-256.

Informational only: it never affects the fused verdict score, so a slow
or unreachable VirusTotal never changes a scan's outcome.

ThreatStats.title: ThreatStats
ThreatStats.description: Richer aggregation backing the threat-tracking dashboard widgets.

TimelineBucket.title: TimelineBucket
TimelineBucket.description: One aggregated bucket for the threat-activity timeline.

novel_threat.title: Novel Threat
novel_threat.description: True when the ML model alone flagged this sample as malicious, with no matching signature or YARA rule -- an unknown/zero-day-style detection.

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: The fused final verdict: static rules AND the ML model, combined.
